pages.title: MIDNIGHT PHANTOM RUNNER
pages.text:
■ In this mini game, you get to experience Phantom's Phantom Thief Simulator.
■ The game ends when your HP reaches 0, or when you come into contact with an area that's collapsed.
■ Your HP drains over time and takes a heavy hit whenever you run into enemies.
■ Choose your favorite character, avoid enemies and collapsed areas, and collect items to run as far as you can.

pages.title: Controls
pages.text:
■ You can change directions by swiping on mobile or by using the WASD/arrow keys on PC.
■ Once your input is registered, your character will automatically move in that direction.
■ She will stop once she can no longer move forward, at which point you can enter another direction to move again.

pages.title: Characters and Personas
pages.text:
■ Each character has a unique Persona.
■ These Personas have skills that are used automatically once the skill gauge is full.
■ Collect coins and treasure chests to fill the skill gauge.

pages.title: Upgrades
pages.text:
■ You can purchase upgrades with training logs earned from clearing missions.
■ To do this, open the Upgrade menu from the mini game's main menu.
■ Upgrades can be reset at any time, and all training logs will be refunded.

pages.title: Items
pages.text:
■ Useful items will appear throughout the game to help you progress.
Coins: Award bonus points and fill the skill gauge. Coins will not fill the skill gauge while a skill is active.
IV bags: Restore HP.
Treasure chests: Greatly fill the skill gauge. Chests will fill the skill gauge even while a skill is active.
Calling cards: Double all points earned for a brief time.
Bombs: Eliminate all enemies within range after a short countdown. Bombs detonate immediately when you run into an enemy, preventing you from losing HP.

pages.title: Combo Bonuses
pages.text:
■ Collect items consecutively within a short time to start a combo. Each time you reach a combo milestone, your combo level increases and you earn bonus points.
■ Once you reach the maximum combo level, your combo will reset and you will receive a large amount of bonus points.
■ Your combo will reset if you fail to collect an item within the time limit, or if you run into an enemy.

pages.title: Enemies
pages.text:
■ A variety of enemies with unique movement patterns will appear throughout the game.
■ If you run into an enemy, you will lose HP and the enemy will be eliminated.
■ You can earn points by using items or your Persona's skill to defeat enemies.

pages.title: Map Collapse
pages.text:
■ Once the game has been going for some time, the map will start collapsing from the back.
■ The collapse will continue to spread in the direction you are moving. If you touch a part of the map that's collapsed, the game will end.
